title: The proposed AC14 credential-shape test is a new automated guard, but the plan does not require a planted-viol
text: The proposed AC14 credential-shape test is a new automated guard, but the plan does not require a planted-violation proof: a concrete safe fixture/file-and-line that fails with the prohibited shape and passes once removed. Saying the test is “written to fail on a real credential” is not the required demonstrated fail/pass verification.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in d731fe1, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
